title: A Crown in the Ashes
text: When the old foundry on the river finally burns out, the ashes give up a crown: iron, nailed together, with a saint's name stamped inside it. Every smith in the city wants it melted. Every House wants it worn. The foundry-master will sell it for iron, not gold.

options.label: Send a sealed bid of iron.

outcomes.text: Your iron is carted to the ruin. The foundry-master weighs it on a scale with a skull on the other pan.
You keep your iron, and watch to see whose head the crown ends up on.

together.text: Nobody bids. The foundry-master puts the crown on his own head, walks into the river, and is not seen again.

prize.text: The crown is yours. Whoever wears it hears the iron saint's last sermon every night, word for word, and stands a little straighter in the morning.
